about_the_game:
Hop on your hoverbike and go guns blazing in this story-driven single-player experience! This is Retronika and it’s time to fight back.

Race through chaotic traffic and vibrant cityscapes in the Retronika VR Demo, face off against towering metallic bosses and relentless drones, and prove who’s truly in charge!

    Expect Chaotic Battles

Engage in high-speed battles, taking down drones and enemy vehicles as you progress.

    Master Your Hoverbike Skills

Take full control of your hoverbike while fighting through and master your movement to survive!

Unravel the Mystery

Venture into Planet Retronika, a once-friendly world that has now turned hostile, and uncover its secrets.

Upgrade. Customize. Dominate.

Get the most out of your hoverbike with powerful upgrades and personalize it with different customizations!

name: Retronika Demo
short_description: Hop on your hoverbike and dive into Retronika’s VR demo! Fight challenging enemies, master 3D movement and shooting, navigate vibrant cityscapes, upgrade your bike, combine weapons, and tackle chaotic missions in this action-packed, single-player experience.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support
